options.content:
🐣 Ninho & Mimo Trends

Os produtos que estão viralizando agora. Seu trabalho é só copiar e vender.

Como usar

  1. Escolha um produto abaixo
  2. Clique em Link Afiliado
  3. Publique nos seus stories/grupos

panels.title: 🏆 Top 1 — Melhor Oportunidade
panels.description: Foto e nome do produto real com maior oportunidade. Clique para gerar seu link afiliado.

links.title: Abrir produto com meu link afiliado

targets.rawSql: WITH latest_score AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (product_id) id, product_id, opportunity_score, calculated_at FROM tb_product_scores WHERE $__timeFilter(calculated_at) ORDER BY product_id, calculated_at DESC), ranked AS (SELECT p.id, p.normalized_name, score.opportunity_score, score.calculated_at, offer.image_url FROM latest_score score JOIN tb_product_indications indication ON indication.product_score_id = score.id JOIN tb_products p ON p.id = score.product_id JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ps.image_url FROM tb_product_sources ps JOIN tb_sources s ON s.id = ps.source_id WHERE ps.product_id = p.id AND s.code = 'shopee_affiliate' AND ps.image_url IS NOT NULL AND ps.original_url IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (COALESCE(ps.sales_count, 0) * COALESCE(ps.current_price, 0) * COALESCE(ps.commission_rate, 0)) DESC, ps.sales_count DESC NULLS LAST, ps.commission_rate DESC NULLS LAST, ps.collected_at DESC LIMIT 1) offer ON true) SELECT id AS "ID", image_url AS "Imagem", normalized_name AS "Produto" FROM ranked ORDER BY opportunity_score DESC, calculated_at DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0

panels.title: 🛒 Todos os Produtos em Alta
panels.description: Lista das 100 melhores oportunidades. O Gold Score combina vendas, crescimento, comissão, potencial de conteúdo e risco.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest_score AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (product_id) id, product_id, opportunity_score, trend_status, calculation_details, calculated_at FROM tb_product_scores WHERE $__timeFilter(calculated_at) ORDER BY product_id, calculated_at DESC) SELECT p.id AS "ID", p.normalized_name AS "Produto", c.name AS "Categoria", score.opportunity_score AS "Oportunidade", COALESCE(score.calculation_details->'gold'->>'stage', 'DESCOBERTA') AS "Estágio", NULLIF(score.calculation_details->'gold'->>'category_percentile', '')::numeric AS "Percentil Categoria", score.trend_status AS "Tendência", COALESCE((SELECT signal.status FROM tb_external_product_signals signal WHERE signal.product_id = p.id AND signal.provider = 'google_trends' ORDER BY signal.collected_at DESC LIMIT 1), 'PENDENTE') AS "Google", COALESCE((SELECT signal.status FROM tb_external_product_signals signal WHERE signal.product_id = p.id AND signal.provider = 'mercado_livre' ORDER BY signal.collected_at DESC LIMIT 1), 'PENDENTE') AS "Mercado Livre", (SELECT count(*) FROM tb_product_clicks pc WHERE pc.product_id = p.id AND pc.clicked_at >= now() - interval '30 days') AS "Cliques 30d", ps.sales_count AS "Vendas", ps.current_price AS "Preço", ps.commission_rate AS "Comissão %", (ps.current_price * ps.commission_rate / 100) AS "Comissão estimada", ps.seller_name AS "Loja", 'Abrir oferta' AS "Link Afiliado", ps.affiliate_url AS "AffiliateURL", ps.image_url AS "Imagem" FROM latest_score score JOIN tb_product_indications indication ON indication.product_score_id = score.id JOIN tb_products p ON p.id = score.product_id JOIN tb_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id JOIN LATERAL (SELECT offer.current_price, offer.commission_rate, offer.sales_count, offer.seller_name, offer.affiliate_url, offer.image_url FROM tb_product_sources offer JOIN tb_sources source ON source.id = offer.source_id WHERE offer.product_id = p.id AND source.code = 'shopee_affiliate' AND offer.affiliate_url IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (COALESCE(offer.sales_count, 0) * COALESCE(offer.current_price, 0) * COALESCE(offer.commission_rate, 0)) DESC, offer.sales_count DESC NULLS LAST, offer.commission_rate DESC NULLS LAST, offer.collected_at DESC LIMIT 1) ps ON true WHERE c.name ~ '${categoria:regex}' ORDER BY score.opportunity_score DESC, score.calculated_at DESC LIMIT 100
